413)༄༅/rtsa gsum srung ma spyi'i gsol bsdus mi pham zhal lung bzhugs/ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/oṃ āḥhūm̐/mchog gsum brgyud gsum bla ma brgyud drug giyi dam la

tei:div.tei:p: rtsa gsum srung ma spyi'i gsol bsdus mi pham zhal lung bzhugs/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchog gsum brgyud gsum bla ma brgyud drug gi yi dam lha tshogs gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma// ma mgon gza' rdor sde gsum srung ma'i tshogs// gsol lo mchod do bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ hūm̐/ lha chen dpal 'bar legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag /gur zhal ber chen phyag bzhi phyag drug sogs// pho rgyud mgon po'i lha tshogs thams cad la// gsol lo mchod do dgra bgegs rdul du rlog bh+yo/ ral gcig srid rgyal re ti dmag zor ma// g.yu sgron bstan ma srog sgrub nag mo sogs// snang srid mo rgyud lha mo'i tshogs rnams la// gsol lo mchod do rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs/ hūm̐/ sde dpon sum cu dregs chen bco brgyad dang// dpal mgon don lnga dregs pa sde brgyad sogs// bka' dang gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gsol lo mchod do bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel/ bswo/ dgra bla bcu gsum mched gsum dra ma brgyad// seng khyung 'brug stag thugs 414)dkar cang shes sogs// snang srid dgra bla wer ma'i tshogs rnams la// gsol lo mchod do phyogs las rnam rgyal mdzod/ hrīḥ rnam sras dzam la nor bdag pho mo brgyad// lha klu banod sbyin mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i// rab 'byams nor lha gter bdag ma lus la// gsol lo mchod do 'dod rgu'i char rgyun phob/ oṃ/ tshangs dang dbang phyug khyab 'jug brgya byin dang// rgyal chen bzhi sogs dkar po'i phyogs 'dzin pa// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha mgon ma lus la// gsol lo mchod do bkra shis bde legs mdzod/ hūm̐/ lo zla zhag dus spar sme gza' skar dang// 'byung lnga snod bcud phyogs dus gnas dang rgyu// btsug lag srid pa rgyud kyi lha rnams kun// gsol lo mchod do zhi dang dge legs stsol/ hūm̐/ 'go ba'i lha lnga skyob pa'i lha dgu dang// rang dang pha mes slob dpon rgyud kyi lha// 'go ba'i lha mgon gnyen po ma lus la// gsol lo mchod do mgon skyabs sdong grogs mdzod/

kyai/ mgul lha bcu gsum dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang*// brtan ma bcu gnyis ri gsum mtsho bzhi sogs// gangs can yul skyong zo dor thams cad la// gsol lo mchod do srungs skyobs 'dod don sgrubs/ ༈ hūm̐/ sded brgyad spyi dang phyogs 415)'di ru// gnas pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag rnams// 'dir gshegs gser skyems mchod pa bzhes// bgegs zhi bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ hūm̐/ rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng la sogs pa// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tha tshig la// gnas pa'i bka' gter chos skyong dam can tshogs// gsol lo mchod do bcol pa'i phrin las sgrubs/ hūm̐/ ye shes dang ni las las grub pa yi// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan dam tshig skyong*// snang srid lha srin dregs pa ma lus la// gsol lo mchod do 'dod yon yongs stsol mdzod/ hūm̐/ rnal 'byor bdag la sngon nas 'brel pa dang// 'phral du 'go zhing sdong grogs mdzad pa yi// mchod cing bstod pa'i mgron du 'os pa kun// gsol lo mchod do bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ phrin bcol ni// gsang sngags snying po nang rgyud sde gsum gyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur sgreng ba dang// gang la log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs// rjes shul med par myur du brlag par mdzod// brgyud gsum bla ma'i spyan sngar dam mnos pa'i// sde gsum dregs pa'i mthu rtsal mngon phyungs la// sprul pa'i ring lugs chos kyi 416)mdzod chen pos// sa gsum khyab par myur du spel bar mdzod/ ces pa'ang gangs can tsam na mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung las khol du phyung te gcig tu 'bri ba po dharma hastis so// dge'o//
